ctx.x: Our first heavyweight championship by a champion fighter, rather. Then on the program there at the Standard Theater, Ethel Waters on the bill and

Sandy Burns is the comedian, Marshall "Garbage" Rogers comedian, at the Standard Theater. Then we had the Berry Brothers. We had Ada Brown and Sam Russell who was a comedian, George Wilshire was a straight man and we had the Lucky Seven Trio, was a dancing trio. Then we played the Fox Theater in Philadelphia and played the Shubert Theater with Herman Timberg's (phonetic spelling) "Frolics of 1922." We played the Pearl Theater in Philadelphia and we played at the southwest Phillie, we played the Pearl and in West…
